title: Editor
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for skilled editors who can generate an article from our brief using AI and then edit it into something a real reader would finish and a client would be proud to publish. You are not a writer and you will not be starting from a blank page. 

You own the piece from generation through to the version that goes to the client. You will work across client industries, currently weighted towards healthcare, with expansion into finance and other verticals.



This is not proofreading. Grammar and spelling are the floor, not the job. The hard part is the human factor. AI will hand you something fluent, confident and completely generic, and your job is to turn that into something that reads like a person who knows the subject wrote it. The finished article has to answer what the reader actually searched for, say something the first three Google results do not, and carry none of the tells that make a reader stop trusting the page.



Engagement Terms

- Tasks are posted in a WhatsApp group on a first come, first served basis, the same group you are added to once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star editor and cleared the test. The first person to claim a task owns it. If it is not delivered by the stated deadline, it goes back to the group.

- There is no minimum volume, but consistent editors get first sight of the bigger jobs.

- You will be given the client's style guide, the SEO brief and the target keyword for each piece.



Key Responsibilities

Writing quality

- Generate the first draft from our brief, target keyword and the SERP competitors using AI. Prompt it with the brief, the competitor pages and the client's existing copy rather than a one-line instruction. The raw output is your starting point, never your deliverable.

- Strip the AI tells before anyone else sees it: uniform paragraph lengths, em dashes, empty openers, hedged claims, lists with nothing specific in them, and confident statements with no source behind them.

- Ensure the text is free from grammar, spelling and punctuation errors.

- Keep the language user-friendly and concise. Cut filler.

- Match the client's house voice, including US or UK spelling as instructed per client.



Reader experience

- Logical: establish authority and credibility using supporting evidence such as statistics, academic publications, case studies, testimonials, Google reviews and relevant endorsements.

 Emotional: create a sense of assurance and connection. Use the PEEL structure (Point, Elaboration, Example, Link) and keep it authentic and relatable.

- Highlight and sharpen the client's unique selling points so the piece does not read like every competitor's page.



SEO checks

- Confirm the draft answers the search intent behind the target keyword. If the ranking pages are comparisons and our draft is a sales page, flag it.

- Target keyword present in the H1, the first 100 words, the meta title and two or three H2s, placed naturally and never stuffed.

- Meta title and meta description within length, keyword front-loaded, appearing once, no filler calls to action.

- Correct heading hierarchy with no skipped levels.

- Internal links to the relevant service pages, with descriptive anchor text.

- Flag missing or unsourced claims and any section that is too thin to stand.



Business and compliance

- Place calls to action strategically, for example after treatments, after benefits, and after the "why choose us" section, rather than one block at the end.

- For healthcare clients, ensure the copy complies with the Healthcare Services (Advertisement) Regulations. Flag superlatives, guarantees, comparative claims and testimonials that cannot stand.



Preferred Skills

- Minimum 1 year of editing experience. Agency or content-marketing experience preferred.

- Working knowledge of SEO. Deep technical SEO is a bonus, not a requirement.

- Able to drive AI tools well (ChatGPT, Claude or similar), and more importantly able to tell when the output is generic and fix it.

- Comfortable working from a brief and a style guide without hand-holding.

- Excellent written English, native or near-native fluency.

- Able to switch between US and UK spelling on instruction.

- Bonus: healthcare or finance content experience.



How to Apply

- Please attach your CV and two published pieces you edited, and name one of them you are still proud of.

- Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: YouTube Video Editor for a Hawaii Real Estate Team (Long-Term, Remote)
description:
Aloha! We are a top-producing real estate team on Oahu, looking for a long-term video editor who can grow into a larger role over time. You will help us create useful, engaging YouTube videos for people making real estate decisions in Hawaii.



See the video and thumbnail examples we like:





WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- Long-form talking-head videos supported by property footage, local B-roll, maps, photos, and graphics for Hawaii buyers and sellers

- Property tours, neighborhood and new-construction videos, and practical videos

- One thoughtfully designed thumbnail for each long-form video, using our brand assets and reference examples

- Roughly one separately paid Short per long-form video, ordered after the long-form receives final approval



WHAT MATTERS MOST



- Story instincts: find the strongest takes, build a clear opening, and keep the video moving naturally

- Clean editing, including dialogue audio, music, color, captions, and pacing

- Clear motion graphics such as maps, comparisons, text callouts, charts, or simple explainers

- Thoughtful, effective thumbnail design that gives viewers a reason to click, works with the video's title, and matches our brand and reference examples

- Good visual judgment: supporting footage should fit Hawaii, the subject, and the people being discussed

- Timely, responsive communication: meet agreed deadlines, reply promptly, and raise questions or potential delays early

- Resourcefulness and ownership: suggest practical solutions when something is missing or unclear, and keep the edit and files organized through final delivery



Thumbnails are a core part of the role. We want a clear idea, strong composition, and readable text at phone size. Use our brand assets and examples as a starting point, and bring your judgment to each video's thumbnail.



Use supplied property footage and local B-roll where relevant. When additional visuals are needed, source or create imagery that fits Hawaii, the subject, and the people being discussed. For a specific property, use its actual footage or photos and flag missing assets rather than substituting another home or inventing one.



AI-assisted visuals and advanced motion graphics are welcome when they help, but are not required in every video. Check AI output carefully for geographic and factual accuracy, natural movement, and visual glitches. Only use results that look realistic and hold up during playback.



TOOLS



Use Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable professional editing software that supports an organized, editable project handoff. We use Google Drive for files and 
 or an equivalent platform for timestamped review. Tell us which tools you work with; we can agree on the setup together.



HOW WE WORK



- Volume: Two to four long-form videos per month, with room to grow as our team and editor have capacity.

- Footage and first draft: Expect new footage on Tuesdays. The video draft and thumbnail are due within 72 hours of receiving the complete footage and brief.

- We provide: Footage, the video's goal, available outlines or scripts, brand assets, and visual references.

- You lead the edit: Shape the story, choose the strongest takes, source or create appropriate supporting visuals, add graphics, refine sound and color, and design the thumbnail. Bring your creative judgment and flag gaps early.

- Before review: Watch the full edit and check the thumbnail for pacing, spelling, audio, visual accuracy, and brand fit.

- Feedback: We leave consolidated timestamped notes in 
 or an equivalent platform. You carry those through to the final files.

- Working hours: You manage your own working hours. Revision and Short deadlines are agreed separately and may extend beyond the initial draft window, including into a weekend by agreement. We work asynchronously with one agreed weekly check-in.



PAY AND DELIVERABLES



A few shortlisted applicants will be invited to a $50 USD paid test using our supplied footage: a 3 to 4 minute edit and one thumbnail. We will share the brief and confirm the 72-hour deadline before you begin. Each finalist is paid for completing the agreed test, whether or not they are hired.



$100 USD per standard video package, normally an 8 to 12 minute finished video, including:



1. Within 72 hours: a complete long-form video draft with supporting visuals, graphics, audio, and color work in place, plus one fully designed thumbnail ready for review.

2. After feedback: the final video export and thumbnail, with one main revision and one final correction pass included.

3. At handoff: organized editable video and thumbnail files, relinkable media, and a short delivery note identifying any sourced or AI-assisted assets.



Shorts are $20 each, ordered separately after the long-form video receives final approval. Expect roughly one Short per long-form video. Turn a strong moment into an engaging vertical video with a clear opening, natural pacing, readable captions, and supporting visuals or sound where they help. Deliver a finished vertical export and include its editable sequence in the project handoff. We agree on the number, length, and deadline before you begin.



TO APPLY



Please include all four items below. We’ll only review complete applications, including two relevant video samples and one thumbnail you designed. Please send direct links, not a general portfolio folder.



Start your message with OAHU STORY, then include the following, using existing work for your samples:



1. Only your two most relevant video samples for this role, including at least one talking-head video with supporting B-roll or graphics. Use direct links to those videos rather than a full portfolio folder or a long list. Tell us what you handled and point to one timestamp showing your best work.

2. One thumbnail you designed, with a sentence about the idea behind it.

3. Your editing software, current availability, and when you could start.

4. A short answer: What would you do if the supplied footage did not include an important visual mentioned by the speaker?



If you have polished AI-assisted video work, you may also share a timestamped example and briefly describe your input and cleanup. This is optional.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes :

title: AI Video Production & Automation Engineer
description:
Who We Are

We are a high-volume AI video production operation serving the Whop clipping ecosystem. We produce hundreds of clips per week across multiple channels and campaigns. We're looking for someone who can design the automation systems that make this possible while maintaining top-tier video quality.



This isn't an editing job—it's an engineering + creative leadership role.



What You'll Do

You will architect end-to-end AI video pipelines that transform raw footage into viral clips ready for platform upload with minimal human intervention. This involves building robust automation systems using FFmpeg, Python or Node.js, and AI APIs such as Whisper for transcription, GPT for content analysis, and OpusClip for intelligent clipping. You will also integrate with Whop's API to streamline campaign submission and payout tracking.



You will design and implement automated quality control systems that predict engagement potential, verify caption accuracy, and enforce format compliance—ensuring every clip meets a consistently high standard before it goes live. You will manage production pipelines capable of delivering 50 to 200+ clips daily across multiple campaigns, channels, and niches simultaneously.



Beyond the technical infrastructure, you will develop feedback loops that continuously train and refine our AI models—improving moment detection, hook generation, and editing decisions over time. You will also build internal tools that empower non-technical editors to work 10x faster without sacrificing creative quality, effectively turning your systems into a force multiplier for the entire team.



🔹 Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) for distributed video processing



🔹 Background in recommendation algorithms or engagement prediction



🔹 Experience managing remote production teams



🔹 Knowledge of TikTok/YouTube Shorts algorithms and optimization strategies



How to Apply

Send us:



Your automation portfolio – describe the most complex video automation pipeline you've built



Code samples – scripts, repos, or architecture diagrams (if available)



Scale metrics – what's the largest volume of videos you've produced in a day/week?



A 1-page proposal – outline how you'd design a system to produce 200 high-quality clips per day from 10 hours of raw footage

Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 qualitative Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen mittlerweile auf unsere Produkte, unser Onlineshop läuft achtstellig. Für 
 
 
 
 Instagram 
 
 ab sofort einen AI Content Creator auf Freelance-Basis, im Schnitt ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche (kann je nach Bedarf schwanken).

- Du erstellst auf Abruf KI-generierten Content für unsere Werbevideos: zum Beispiel Avatare (Personen, die vor der Kamera sprechen) oder bestimmte Szenen, die wir sonst mit Stockmaterial füllen müssten.

- Idealerweise hast du bereits Content für E-Commerce-Marken erstellt, das ist aber kein Muss.

- Du arbeitest zuverlässig, hältst Absprachen und Deadlines ein und meldest dich zeitnah zurück.

- Eine flexible Freelance-Zusammenarbeit mit im Schnitt ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche, die sich je nach unserem Bedarf entwickeln kann.

- Klare Anfragen über unser Projekt-Tool, du musst dir das Konzept nicht selbst überlegen.

- Direkte, unkomplizierte Kommunikation, kurze Abstimmungswege.

Schick uns bitte direkt mit deiner Bewerbung ein paar Beispiele deiner bisherigen KI-Content-Arbeit (idealerweise für E-Commerce oder Werbevideos) sowie ein bis zwei Sätze zu dir. Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung mit Portfolio an und melden uns zeitnah zurück.



Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Community & Course Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) Community, Course & Implementation Specialist to build and prepare Hire Culture’s community and learning ecosystem for launch.



This is a project-based engagement focused on translating our existing community strategy, member journey, processes, policies, learning structure, and content direction into a functional, organized, scalable, and easy-to-manage GHL environment.



The project will include building three GHL communities, the RTM Academy and course environment, workflows and automations, reusable templates, custom domain configuration, testing, documentation, and final handoff.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow instructions. The ideal candidate should understand GHL architecture, recommend best practices, think through the member and learning experience, and build systems that the Hire Culture team can confidently manage and expand after the project is complete.



Core Responsibilities



1. GHL Community & Academy Build

• Build and configure three GHL communities based on Hire Culture’s approved structure and member journey.

 • Build the RTM Academy, including course categories, modules, lessons, instructors, resources, and member access.

 • Ensure the community and Academy are organized, user-friendly, and scalable.



2. Member & Learning Experience

• Translate the approved member journey into GHL.

 • Configure access, navigation, messaging, and learning flows so members clearly understand where to start and what to do next.

 • Connect the Community and Academy experience where appropriate.



3. Domains, Workflows & Automations

• Configure and test custom domains/subdomains and required DNS settings.

 • Build and test workflows for onboarding, community access, events, courses, notifications, and follow-ups.

 • Organize automations so they are easy for the HC team to manage.



4. Templates, Content & Documentation

• Implement HC-provided content, course materials, videos, and resources into GHL.

 • Create reusable community, course, and workflow templates for future use.

 • Develop clear SOPs for managing members, communities, courses, workflows, and basic system updates.



5. Testing & Handoff

• Test the system from both member and administrator perspectives.

 • Identify and resolve issues before launch.

 • Provide a final admin walkthrough and complete project handoff to the HC team.



Required Qualifications & Skills



• Strong professional experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).

 • Advanced understanding of GHL architecture, workflows, automations, and system setup.

 • Hands-on experience building GHL Communities.

 • Strong experience building courses, memberships, or learning environments inside GHL.

 • Experience setting up course structures, modules, lessons, instructors, access, and learning components.

 • Experience with custom domains, subdomains, DNS configuration, and GHL domain setup.

 • Strong understanding of CRM systems, automation, tagging, permissions, and member journeys.

 • Strong attention to detail and quality assurance skills.

 • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Hire Culture team.

 • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot technical issues.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building professional communities, membership platforms, or online academies.

 • Experience connecting community and course experiences within GHL.

 • Experience building scalable learning systems designed for future course expansion.

 • Experience with domain architecture and multi-domain or subdomain environments.

 • Experience creating SOPs and documentation for non-technical teams.

 • Experience recommending GHL best practices and improving existing business processes.

 • Experience working on project-based GHL implementations from discovery through final handoff.

 • Experience supporting organizations with multiple audiences, programs, or communities.



Project Structure & Timeline - Project-Based Engagement



• Target Timeline: 60–90 days

 • Initial Estimate: Approximately 100 project hours, subject to validation once final requirements are confirmed

 • Work will be managed based on deliverables and milestones, not simply hours worked.

 • Each phase will have clear deliverables and approval before moving forward.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit:

title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)
description:
DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$80k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: REAL ESTATE SOCIAL MEDIA ADS & LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST
description:

This is not simply a social media posting or Canva position.



We want someone who understands the entire process:



AD → LEAD → CRM → FOLLOW-UP → APPOINTMENT



Our goal isn’t just likes, followers or views. We want qualified leads and measurable results.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You will help create, launch, manage and improve marketing campaigns for our real estate business, including:



•
 & Instagram paid advertising

• Buyer and seller lead generation

• Property/listing advertisements

• Home valuation and local market campaigns

• Reels, videos and social media content

• Retargeting campaigns

• Landing pages and lead forms

• Organizing social media inquiries and leads

• CRM integration and automated follow-up

Strong Meta Ads Manager/Facebook/Instagram Ads experience is important.



Experience with Google Ads, TikTok, YouTube, Follow Up Boss, Zapier, Canva, video editing, SEO, AEO and marketing automation is a major plus.



You should understand things like CPL, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, targeting, retargeting, A/B testing and campaign optimization.



If an ad isn’t working, we want someone who can figure out why and tell us what should change.



SHOW US YOUR ACTUAL RESULTS



We are much more interested in what you’ve actually accomplished than certificates or impressive job titles.



Your application MUST include:



• Your current resume

• Examples of paid ads YOU personally created or managed

• Screenshots or proof that your ads generated actual leads

• Ad spend, number of leads and cost per lead when available

• A short explanation of one of your best campaigns



You may blur confidential client information.



We want to see:



MONEY SPENT → ADS CREATED → LEADS GENERATED → COST PER LEAD



If you’ve generated appointments or sales from those leads, we’d love to see that too.



COMMUNICATION & ENGLISH



This position will involve working directly with a U.S.-based real estate team, so strong spoken and written English communication is important.



You must be:



• Comfortable speaking English in live conversations

• Confident communicating with Americans and U.S.-based team members

• Comfortable being on camera

• Available for occasional video calls and team meetings

• Able to clearly explain your ideas, strategies and campaign results



INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



Please upload a short 1–2 minute introduction video of yourself speaking in English.



Nothing fancy is required. Your phone or webcam is perfectly fine.



Tell us:



Who are you?

What experience do you have?

Why are you good at social media advertising and lead generation?

Why would you be a good fit for our team?



We want to get a feel for your English communication, confidence, personality and energy.



SHOW US WHAT YOU CAN DO



We also want a quick sample using one of our real properties:



13690 Sudbury Dr — Pickerington, Ohio



4 bedrooms | 3 bathrooms | 2,500+ total finished sq. ft.



Features include a finished basement, large paved patio, garden, backyard entertaining area, bonfire area, shed, additional parking and a large lot.



CREATE A SAMPLE AD



Pretend we hired you to generate leads from this listing.



Create ONE sample
/Instagram advertisement.



Include:



• Your finished ad creative

• Headline

• Ad copy

• Call-to-action

• Who you would target

• How you would capture the lead

• What should happen after the lead comes in



Then answer:



YOU HAVE $500 — WHAT WOULD YOU DO?



If we gave you $500 in advertising budget for this property:



How would you spend it?



How long would you run the campaign?



What would you test?



What metrics would you watch?



What would make you change or stop an ad?



You do NOT need to actually spend any money. We simply want to see how you think.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



Creative • Analytical • Organized • Dependable • Responsive • Confident • Fun to work with



We especially want someone who brings ideas to the table.



Don’t always wait for us to tell you what to do. If you see an opportunity, tell us:



“I have an idea. I think we should try this.”



You should stay current on social media trends, advertising strategies, popular content, SEO/AEO, lead-generation strategies and new ways to reach potential buyers and sellers.



You should also understand that someone who comments, messages or submits a form is an opportunity that needs to be captured, organized and followed up with.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



• Resume

• 1–2 minute English introduction video

• Previous paid-ad examples

• Proof/screenshots of actual lead-generation results

• Your Sudbury Drive sample advertisement

• Your $500 campaign strategy

• Your availability/work schedule

• Your expected compensation



Somewhere in the subject line or title of your application, include the word STARFISH. There is no need to explain why.



Applications missing the required materials may not be considered.



ONE LAST THING…



We aren’t looking for someone who only knows how to make things look pretty.



We want someone who can combine:



CREATIVITY + PAID ADS + DATA + LEAD GENERATION + FOLLOW-UP



If you can create great content, get it in front of the right people, turn those people into leads, track the results and continuously make the process better, we’d love to hear from you.



Come show us what you can do for 614RLTR Group!

title: Video Editor — FPV Drone & Real Estate | DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
description:
Video Editor — FPV Drone & Real Estate | DaVinci Resolve + After Effects | Long-Term

 

Rate: $10–15 USD/hour, depending on experience

Hours: 10–20 per week to start, growing toward full-time

Schedule: Flexible. No fixed shift, no required US hours.

Software: DaVinci Resolve + After Effects (required), Gyroflow (required)

Type: Long-term. I am hiring one editor to grow with.



Before you apply



This is a specialist role, not a general editing role.



I need a colorist and motion graphics editor who understands FPV drone footage, log color pipelines, and sound design at a professional level.



If you cannot grade log footage in DaVinci Resolve and build motion-tracked graphics in After Effects, please do not apply. I would rather you save your time. If you can do those things, keep reading — the work is genuinely interesting and I pay every week, on time.



About Vantage Studio



I run a cinematography company in Northern California. I shoot FPV drone work, aerial cinematography, and real estate video for brokerages, commercial property owners, local businesses, and motorsports teams.



I am FAA-certified with waivers to fly over people and over moving vehicles. That matters for you because it means the footage you will be cutting is not typical drone work. It is close, fast, and shot inside spaces most operators are not legally allowed to fly.



Why I am hiring: I have been editing everything myself, and I no longer have the hours to do it properly at the volume my clients need. I am not looking for someone to replace my taste. I am looking for someone to execute at my standard, consistently, so I can stay behind the camera.



Because I edit all of this myself, two things are true. I know exactly how long each task takes. And my feedback will be specific and technical — you will never get "make it better" from me.



The standard I am chasing



Below are reference examples of the caliber of work I am building toward — one for each type of work you would be doing. For each, I have noted exactly what I want you to look at.



Commercial real estate — 
 → [ what to notice, e.g. Use of FPV Drone shots and motion-tracked text, as well as a professional, constrained editing style while still being engaging ]



Trending residential reel — 
 → [ what to notice, e.g. the pacing, and how the tracked text sits in the scene, transitions, flow, sound design]



FPV one-take — 
 → [ what to notice, e.g. the sound design and where the hidden cuts are, smooth speed ramps and flow, motion treacked logo ]



FPV one-take, second example — 
 → [ what to notice, e.g. the sound design and flow of the speed ramps ]



Aerial map/motion graphics — 
 → [ what to notice, e.g. how the lot lines and street names stay locked to the ground, the level of detail in aerial and satellite maps ]



If this is the level you already work at, we should talk.



The work — four types



1. Residential real estate reels — 1 to 3 per week



Short-form vertical listing videos with modern, trend-aware editing:



Motion-tracked subtitles and text

Masking and object isolation

Smooth speed ramps

AI-assisted effects and AI home renders / visualizations

Clean grade from log footage



2. Commercial real estate videos — roughly 1 per week (not guaranteed every week)



The same craft, executed more conservatively and more corporate:



Polished, professional subtitle design

FPV drone sequences with motion graphic text integrated into the shot

Aerial map graphics built in After Effects, with motion-tracked overlays: street names, surrounding business callouts, lot lines and property boundaries, satellite map pulls

Deliverables per property vary — long-form horizontal, vertical reels, short teasers



3. FPV one-take videos — the flagship work



Single continuous drone takes for local businesses (gyms, restaurants, retail), motorsports (sprint car racing), and commercial property tours. These are the pieces that win me clients, and the edit is what makes or breaks them. Required:



Gyroflow stabilization. Not optional. I need someone who has genuinely used it.

Log color grading in Resolve, matched across the entire take

Silky, invisible speed ramps

Seamless hidden cuts — masked transitions as the drone passes behind an object

Real sound design: whooshes tied to camera movement, ambience beds, actor dialogue, layered SFX, audio that fades naturally as the drone approaches and passes a subject, and comfort with EQ, compression, and other processing when a source needs fixing



4. Short-form social and paid ads



Content for Vantage Studio itself — promotional videos, educational social content, and paid ad creative. This needs to be high-engagement and professional, with advanced motion graphics. If you have edited ads that performed well, tell me about it.



Three things matter more than anything else:



- Color grading. Everything I shoot is log. A clean, consistent, cinematic base is the foundation of all of it.

- Sound design. Good audio is half of why an FPV one-take feels good.

- Flow. Pacing, rhythm, how one shot hands off to the next. This is the part I cannot teach.



Required — please do not apply unless all of these are true:



- Fluent, natural spoken and written English. We will be on video calls together. This is not negotiable.

- Extensive DaVinci Resolve experience, specifically grading log footage — node-based grading, color management, shot matching

- Strong After Effects skills — motion graphics, motion tracking, masking

- Gyroflow experience for FPV stabilization

- Professional sound design ability. Not just adding a music track.

- Prior US real estate video experience

- Prior FPV or drone footage experience

- Able to work from a written brief and hit deadlines without being chased

- Reliable internet with solid upload speed, plus a backup connection



Strongly preferred:



- Real estate photo editing in an architectural or editorial style — HDR blending and luxury flambient work: natural warmth, sun flare on exteriors, sun rays through interior windows, sky replacement, twilight conversion

- Graphic design on aerial stills — business callouts, street name overlays, lot line and property boundary overlays, satellite maps

- Experience with motorsports, action, or automotive content



What I provide:



- Organized footage with selects marked, delivered by Google Drive or 

- A written brief for every project

- Brand kit — LUTs, fonts, title and lower-third templates, music library

- Fast, specific, technical feedback. Usually one or two rounds of notes per project.

- Direction on brand and style, so you are never guessing what I want



How pay works:



- Paid every Friday, for the week just finished. No waiting on invoices.

- I cover the transfer fees. The rate we agree on is exactly what lands in your account.

- Hourly for the first month, then a flat weekly rate so your income is predictable.

- Year-end bonus every December, 13th-month style, pro-rated for your first year. As a US client, I am not required to do this. I do it because I know it matters, and I budget for it from your first week.

- Raises as you take on more, and a real path to full-time hours.



I can pay through Wise, Payoneer, or OnlineJobs EasyPay — whichever is easiest for you.



About the schedule:



There is no fixed shift and you do not need to work US hours. I am in California, so I will usually send footage at the end of my day and review your work the next morning. I do need you reachable at some point during your own working day so questions do not sit for 24 hours. Otherwise, work when you work best.



Philippine holidays: I do not set deadlines on your public holidays. Take them. Once you are on the flat weekly rate, a holiday week is paid the same as any other week. Just send me your dates in advance — and tell me early if a storm is likely to knock you offline, so I can plan around it instead of wondering where you went.



How to apply — follow this exactly



Applications that skip steps will not be read. That is intentional.



Step 1. Start your message with the word VANTAGE.



Step 2. Send links to your work. Please do not send a general agency showreel. I want to see three specific things:



One FPV or drone piece you personally edited and graded — a one-take if you have one

One example of motion-tracked graphics or an aerial map overlay

One before/after of a log grade if you have it (ungraded log beside your final)



For each link, tell me in one line what you personally did on it.



Step 3. Answer these four questions. Short answers are completely fine. I am reading for whether you know the work, not for essay length.



Walk me through your node structure when you grade a log clip in Resolve. How do you get to a neutral, correct base before you start building a creative look?

What is your Gyroflow workflow? Tell me about a time the stabilization did not come out clean, and what you did about it.

I want a lot line overlay and a street name that stay locked to the ground in a moving aerial shot. How do you build that in After Effects?

A drone flies past a person who is talking. Describe what you are doing to the audio across those few seconds.



Step 4. Tell me:



Your rate expectation in USD per hour

Your current availability in hours per week

Who else you are currently working for, and how many hours you are committed to them

Your internet upload speed

The paid trial



Shortlisted candidates do two short paid test edits using real footage from my projects — one FPV one-take, and one trending-style residential reel. They test different skills, so I need to see both. Each is a flat fee, paid on delivery.



I never ask anyone to work for free.



I read every application personally, and I reply to everyone who follows the steps above.

title: High Ticket Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter
description:
Role Location: Remote (Philippines-based) Work Schedule: Full-Time | UK Business Hours (8:00 AM – 8:00 PM BST)



Target Audience: High-Net-Worth UK Property



Investors Sales Profile: High-Ticket Outbound Prospecting & Setting



Remuneration: Competitive Base Rate + Uncapped



High-Ticket Bonuses Employment Type: Full-Time Permanent



1. Role Overview



We are looking for an ambitious, highly resilient, and persuasive High-Ticket Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter to join our team. In this role, you will be making outbound calls to a database of over 1,000 UK-based property investors. Your primary objective is to engage high-net-worth investors, qualify their capital capacity and investment goals, build rapid rapport, and book high-quality appointments onto our Senior Director’s calendar for our premium, high-ticket 'Done-For-You' Turnkey Property Investment Service. Because this involves high-ticket investment offerings, you must excel in professional communication, executive-level rapport building, and articulate value-driven conversations. If you thrive in high-volume cold calling, possess an exceptional command of spoken English, and know how to navigate high-ticket objections smoothly, this role offers exceptional earning potential, stability, and ongoing support.



2. Key Responsibilities



· High-Volume Outbound Prospecting: Execute 100+ outbound calls daily to a database of UK property investors using our CRM and auto-dialer setup.



· High-Ticket Qualification & Booking: Qualify leads against strict investor criteria (liquid capital, readiness, and fit) and secure confirmed high-ticket sales appointments directly onto the Senior Director's calendar.



· Attendance & Show-Up Management: Manage pre-call nurture sequences via SMS,
, and WhatsApp to ensure maximum attendance rates and follow up rigorously with any missed appointments.



· Executive Objection Handling: Confidently navigate gatekeepers, brush-offs, and high-ticket investor objections (e.g., market timing, capital deployment, trust) using proven conversational frameworks.



· CRM & Data Maintenance: Accurately log call notes, investor profiles, dispositions, follow-up dates, and lead statuses in our CRM immediately after every interaction.



· Performance Optimization: Participate in regular script reviews, call audits, and team coaching sessions to continuously optimize contact-to-booking conversion rates for high-ticket offers.



3. Requirements & Qualifications



· High-Ticket Sales Experience: Minimum 2+ years of successful experience in high-ticket outbound cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting (B2B or high-ticket B2C). Direct experience in UK real estate, property investment, or wealth services is strongly preferred.



· Exceptional English Fluency: Near-native spoken and written English. Must possess clear pronunciation, neutral accent, strong active listening abilities, and conversational flexibility (able to speak naturally without sounding like reading from a script).



· Resilience & Drive: High energy, grit, and the emotional intelligence required to maintain momentum and positivity through high-volume cold call rejection in a premium sales environment.



· UK High-Net-Worth Market Knowledge: Familiarity with British workplace communication styles, professional business tone, and high-net-worth property terminology.



· Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with modern CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce), circleloop dialers, and calendar tools (Google Calendar / Calendly).



4. Technical & Home Office Requirements



· Computer System: Core i5 / Ryzen 5 processor or higher with at least 8GB RAM (16GB preferred).



· High-Speed Internet: Reliable fiber connection with minimum 25-50 Mbps download/upload speed, plus a secondary backup connection (mobile hotspot or backup ISP).



· Audio Equipment: Professional noise-canceling USB headset with a clear, broadcast-quality microphone.



· Work Environment: A dedicated, quiet, noise-free home office space conducive to continuous professional calling.



5. How to Apply



To demonstrate your attention to detail, please follow these application steps precisely: Step 1: Submit an up-to-date CV / Resume highlighting your high-ticket cold calling and appointment setting achievements. Step 2: Record a 60-second audio voice introduction explaining why you are the ideal fit for calling high-net-worth UK property investors. Step 3: Send your application with the subject line: 'High-Ticket Sales Setter – [Your Full Name]'. Please Note: Applications submitted without an audio sample will not be reviewed.

description:
Role Overview



Candidates with genuine, hands-on Claude experience — well beyond basic chat use — will be prioritised. This is close to a non-negotiable requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have.



An electrical trade services business needs a highly organised, process-driven Administration Coordinator to own enquiries, invoicing, payroll inputs, records, and SOP documentation. This is not a receptionist role — the phone is already handled by an automated phone assistant — and it is not a bookkeeping role either; bookkeeping sits permanently with an external bookkeeper. The role is best understood as the connective tissue that turns a business currently run out of a couple of people's heads into one with proper systems behind it.



Every technical, on-the-tools decision is deliberately kept out of this role — it runs on lookup tables, written procedures, and a "draft, show, send" review rule — so success depends on accuracy, follow-through on chasing (invoices, quotes, records), and genuine comfort with writing documentation. Just as important: this business already runs a real chunk of its systems-improvement work through Claude, connected to its core platforms via MCP, and it needs someone who can operate at that level from day one — reading job data, spotting patterns, and building or improving tools and reports with it, not just cleaning up a reply.



The role is deliberately split into two phases: phase one (below) is the job from day one, with phase two — quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin — held back until phase one is running smoothly, expected around November 2026.



Working Hours: 8AM - 4PM AEST



What You'll Own



Enquiries & Job Creation



Triage incoming enquiries from shared inboxes

Forward enquiries into the job management system so the job gets created

Check the customer against existing records before creating a job, to avoid duplicate customer records

Use the correct job template so the job category is set from the start

Chase the photos and information a job needs before it can be quoted

Record how the customer heard about the business



Invoicing (worked twice weekly, oldest first)



Confirm the job is finished and has a work-done description

Capture who attended and the hours on site

Identify the correct payer behind the site record (often not the site itself)

Apply standing service call-out charges where relevant

Apply after-hours, weekend and public holiday loadings

Confirm the job category is set, then send the invoice

Chase overdue invoices

Reconcile job-management invoices against the accounting system (visibility only, not bookkeeping ownership)

Collect and bank cash and cheques



Payroll Inputs (inputs only — not bookkeeping)



Prepare labour hire timesheets for management approval

Track time-off-in-lieu and rostered-day-off balances

Track apprentice study/holiday days

Supply the bookkeeper with hours, leave, and other relevant data ahead of each pay run



Supplier Bills (limited, escalation-only scope)



Answer the bookkeeper's weekly list of supplier bills that could not be matched to a job

Escalate any bill still unmatched after a fortnight to management



Records & Systems



Maintain job management system forms and templates

Maintain client and site records

Keep the administration task board tidy (a separate board from the crew operations board)



Documentation & SOPs



Draft SOPs for review and correction

Record walkthrough videos

Sit in a weekly short check-in with the operations lead



Compliance & Registers



Maintain a register of who holds which licence, ticket, and clearance, with expiry dates

Renew workers compensation and obtain the certificate of currency

Maintain client compliance portals

Coordinate background/police checks for care and school sites



Projects & Continuous Improvement (this is a real, ongoing part of the role — not a side task)



Use MCP connections between core business platforms and Claude to pull job history and have Claude analyse it — spotting the most profitable job types, workflow bottlenecks, and optimisation opportunities — then implement the resulting recommendations

Build out and maintain a Claude-generated SOP library from the business's ~190-task list and job descriptions, currently structured but not yet fully populated

Evaluate whether platform add-ons are worth adopting, then set them up and train the team

Identify what in existing systems is slow, wrong, or duplicated, and fix it

Take on management-directed improvement projects — largely done with Claude, drafting procedures, reading job data, and building reporting

Support estimating and tender tooling built with Claude as it matures (e.g. a take-off tool for RFQs, currently in development) — expected to grow over time rather than a day-one expectation

Keep a shared Claude context/reference set current (roughly an hour a week)



Explicitly not part of this role: bookkeeping (bank reconciliation, bill coding, pay runs, BAS), and answering the phone. Not part of phase one: quoting, scheduling, purchasing, vehicle/asset admin, and marketing admin.



What We're Looking For



Technical Proficiency — Claude/AI (the d
 factor for this role)



Genuine, hands-on Claude proficiency well beyond a basic chat window is close to a non-negotiable

Comfortable with MCP-connected tools and Claude Code — able to read data and build things with it, even without being a formal programmer

On a simple 1–10 self-assessment scale where 2–3 means "clean this reply up, polish this document," this role needs someone meaningfully above that level — someone who can independently pull data, spot patterns, and build or improve a tool or workflow with Claude

Structured Claude/AI training is available in-house for a strong candidate who needs to sharpen specific skills — but this role is not a starting point for someone beginning from zero



Experience



3+ years' experience as a VA, Executive Assistant, or in operations/administration

Experience in a fast-growing or actively systemising small business is a plus

Trade, construction, or field-services background preferred, not required



Communication Skills



Strong written English suitable for customer-facing
s sent in the business's own name

Comfortable working within a "draft, show, send" review process rather than sending unsupervised

Plain, direct communication style — short, clear, no jargon



Other Technical Proficiency



Job management platform experience is an advantage, not a requirement — full training provided

Familiarity with common accounting, task-board, and Google Workspace tools is helpful, but none of it is assumed

Bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, and payroll processing skills are not required — this sits with an external bookkeeper



Organisational Skills



Naturally documents processes — writes the procedure down the second time they do something

Holds the full list of open items and notices what has been dropped

High attention to detail with money — understands that an invoice going out light is money gone



Non-Negotiables



Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing — explicitly encouraged, never penalised

Chases overdue invoices and unanswered quotes without being prompted

Able to take on an improvement project independently and return with a working solution

Genuinely curious about systems — enjoys finding what's slow, duplicated, or broken in a workflow and fixing it, including by using Claude and connected tools to analyse data and implement improvements

Comfortable stepping into a business mid-rebuild, where some things are well documented and others are not yet written

Willing to draft documentation from a blank page where nothing exists yet

Adjusts well to a role being deliberately re-scoped in phases

Comfortable working within a values-led business culture



Why This Role



Real ownership of the systems and processes behind a growing trade services business

A genuine, ongoing opportunity to work at an advanced level with Claude on real improvement projects — not just admin support work

Clear phased scope so you can master the core before taking on more

Direct, close collaboration with the Director and Operations Manager as the business systemises, with a long-term view toward significant autonomy as the business grows



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — it helps us shortlist quickly:

  * B-roll generation

Send:

 Revenue**

/Messaging

title: Meta AI Video Editor | $1000-1200, Long Term
description:
Read the whole post. Applications that don't follow the format at the bottom get deleted, unread. We get a lot of applications and this is how we really find YOU.



We're Dreaver. We get people moving. Our main product right now is a treadmill for home. We sell direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership, extra time or workouts. We run ads in the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden — more markets and products will follow later. Creative is the lever that moves the needle for us, and we want to get an editor to own our AI video output long-term.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your reel is weddings, corporate or long-form YouTube, we won't be a good client for you.



What you'd be doing

1. Primary: Creating AI (cartoon) videos with Higgsfield, Elevenlaps among others. Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing. Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards. Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero.

2. Secondary: Cutting general UGC and founder footage into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5. Hook variants tested against each other.



Multiple markets, no problem

No need to speak Danish or Swedish, natives on the team handle scripting and copy per market, you bring the editing eye. A creative sense for scripting and concepting, someone who can push back on a script or suggest a better opening, is a big plus.



How we work

Creative is organised by angle and by market: proven angles we scale, angles we're expanding, angles we're testing. Ownership matters — you don't wait for a brief to fix what you can already see.



Tools

Premiere Pro or CapCut. Genuinely fluent in Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, second nature, not "I've tried it once."



What we offer

- Full-time, 40 hours

- $
per month, based on your level

- Perform well and you grow with us — more scope, better pay

- Work when and where you work best. No fixed hours or timezone.

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project.



How to apply

 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years editing DR ads] | [months using Higgsfield] | [length in seconds of the AI video you're sending]



Example: Anna Nowak | 3 | 7 | 24



Then in the body, exactly these six lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only.



1. Best DR ad:

2. What it sold and how it performed:

3. Best AI (cartoon) video:

4. Tools used, and which parts are AI vs filmed:

5. Best moment in the ad from line 1 — timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

6. Loom link (90 seconds max, camera on): open one of the two videos on your screen and talk us through one editing decision, and why. We want to hear how you think.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, "I am hardworking and a fast learner," or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We reply to everyone who follows the format.

title: Asset Protection Analyst
description:
Asset Protection Analyst

Philippines – Remote

Compensation: up to 40,000 php per month



THE COMPANY

DTiQ is a global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets.



With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.



We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.



For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (
).

________________________________________

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Asset Protection Analyst to join our team and help identify potential theft, fraud, policy violations, training gaps, and operational issues through data-driven analysis.



In this role, you will work closely with Investigators, Auditors, and client representatives to turn point-of-sale (POS) data, exception-based reports, video evidence, and other investigative resources into actionable insights. Your analysis will help clients understand emerging risks, strengthen operational controls, and support successful investigations and case resolutions.



This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, spotting patterns others may miss, conducting investigative research, and turning findings into clear recommendations and actionable outcomes.



Application Link: 
 

________________________________________

WHY JOIN US?

• Competitive salary and benefits package 

• Opportunities for career growth and advancement 

• Supportive team environment and leadership 

• Comprehensive training provided 

• Exposure to international clients and business operations 

• Work in a dynamic and fast-paced industry 

________________________________________

THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU IF YOU…

• Are goal-oriented and take pride in delivering high-quality work 

• Have strong attention to detail and observation skills 

• Can manage your time effectively and meet deadlines 

• Are comfortable handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment 

• Are willing to learn new systems and technologies 

• Communicate clearly and professionally in English 

• Enjoy working both independently and as part of a team 

________________________________________

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Data Analysis & Asset Protection

• Analyze POS transactions and exception-based reports to identify potential theft, dishonest activity, policy violations, training opportunities, and systemic issues across assigned client accounts.

• Review transaction activity alongside available video footage to validate unusual or potentially suspicious activity at store or restaurant level.

• Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks that may contribute to financial loss or operational challenges.



Investigative Support

• Generate and initiate potential case leads based on data analysis and investigative findings.

• Provide investigators with relevant data, transaction details, video findings, and other supporting information to facilitate effective investigations and case closure.

• Conduct additional research on POS and video information when requested by investigators or management.

• Use available investigative technologies, systems, and resources to support case development and resolution.

• Develop clear, detailed reports outlining identified issues, findings, supporting evidence, and relevant trends.



Reporting & Follow-Up

• Prepare regular management reports summarizing exception analysis, identified trends, potential cases, and key findings.

• Provide detailed reports and actionable insights to designated client contacts for review and follow-up.

• Maintain accurate case notes and documentation, including follow-up actions and resolutions, to support future analysis and investigations.

________________________________________

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

• Experience in data analysis, fraud analysis, loss prevention, audit, compliance, investigations, business intelligence, or a related analytical function is an advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify meaningful patterns and anomalies in large or complex datasets.

• Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to reviewing information and evidence.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with data reporting or business intelligence tools.

• Ability to interpret and communicate data clearly through reports, findings, and recommendations.

• Comfortable working with multiple systems and data sources simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.



Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with remote and cross-functional teams.

Sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when handling sensitive information.

A curious, investigative mindset and the ability to ask the right questions when something does not appear to be normal.

________________________________________

How to Apply



Application Link: 
 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS).  This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.   



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings.  Our HRIS system will require you to:



• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll. 

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally).  We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard. 

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV. 



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates.  The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).  

Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment.  This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations.    This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team.  Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations.  DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development.  If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you. 



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel. 



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.

We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps.  If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help. 



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.
