title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — NZ Life Insurance | 60-Day Trial
description:
We're hiring one experienced individual cold caller for a 60-day New Zealand life-insurance appointment-setting trial. If we achieve the commercial targets and it's a good fit on both sides, there is potential for an ongoing role.



THE WORK

High-volume cold outbound calls to supplied NZ leads. Expect frequent refusals and some inactive numbers. Start natural conversations, qualify interested prospects and book agreed, exact-time callbacks with a licensed insurance adviser. You will not sell policies or give financial advice.



Qualification: ages 25–59; NZ citizen or resident; regularly employed or self-employed; and either existing life insurance to compare, or a need for cover such as dependents or a mortgage. Record answers accurately, respect refusals and opt-outs, and never turn a tentative interest into a confirmed booking.



We supply leads, calling tools, CRM and onboarding. Maintain accurate call outcomes, callbacks and booking records. We assess quality conversations and qualified bookings alongside calling activity; dead numbers are not treated as caller failure. Calls and records will be reviewed for coaching and quality assurance.



HOURS AND TRIAL

40 paid hours/week, Monday–Friday, 10am–7pm Auckland time with a one-hour unpaid break. This is 6am–3pm Philippines during NZ standard time and 5am–2pm during NZ daylight saving. You must accommodate both schedules. The 60-day trial starts on your first paid working day and includes onboarding.



PAY

Hourly base plus uncapped performance bonuses for valid qualified bookings. Please state your expected USD hourly base. Exact base, bonus amounts and validation rules will be agreed before starting; no earnings level is guaranteed.



WHO FITS

An individual who personally does the calling, with demonstrated cold-calling and appointment-setting experience, clear telephone communication, resilience after rejection, accurate reporting and the ability to follow a process independently. NZ/Australian consumer calling or insurance experience is useful. Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a usable headset are required. Agencies or substitute callers are not suitable for this trial.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer these points:

1. Confirm the exact shift above, your earliest start date and any conflicting work commitments.

2. Your expected USD hourly base and interest in base plus booking bonuses.

3. An ordinary recent week of cold calling: campaign/lead type, hours, dial attempts, actual prospect conversations and agreed timed bookings. Label estimates and distinguish cold calls from warm leads or live transfers. Name your dialler/CRM.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording: introduce relevant experience, give a natural cold opener and ask an interested prospect for an exact adviser callback time. A simple phone recording or accessible recording link is fine; do not share confidential customer recordings.

5. Give an example of handling a difficult calling day and maintaining accurate results without close supervision.



Shortlisted applicants will have a 20–25 minute voice interview. Finalists will complete the same paid practical audition and be asked for a recent supervisor reference. Include 2–3 suitable interview times with your timezone.



Michael

title: Experienced U.S. Trucking Fleet Manager / Dispatcher – Remote
description:
That Ford Girl Trucking — A Trucking Agency is looking for an experienced Fleet Manager/Dispatcher to join our growing U.S.-based trucking operation.



This is not a virtual assistant position and not an entry-level dispatch position. We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. trucking, freight markets, load boards, broker negotiations, driver management, HOS, trip planning, and how dispatch decisions affect truck revenue.



Your primary responsibility is simple: make good fleet and dispatch decisions, plan ahead, negotiate strong freight, and keep assigned drivers moving safely and productively.



Responsibilities

Search load boards and approved freight sources for profitable loads

Evaluate rates, mileage, deadhead, market conditions, HOS and truck positioning

Negotiate rates with U.S. freight brokers — do not simply accept the first rate offered

Book and dispatch freight

Plan reloads and backhauls before trucks become empty

Monitor driver locations, HOS, appointments and home-time needs

Communicate professionally with drivers and brokers

Handle routine load issues and know when something needs to be escalated

Track detention, layover, TONU and other accessorial situations

Keep fleet/load information updated

Help maximize truck productivity while making sound operational decisions

What We're Looking For



You should have previous hands-on experience dispatching U.S. trucks and be comfortable making decisions independently.



Strong candidates will understand RPM, deadhead, freight markets, rate negotiation, HOS, appointment scheduling and how to position a truck for its next load.



Negotiation ability and revenue awareness are extremely important to us. We want a Fleet Manager who understands that an additional $100–$200 negotiated onto a load matters and is willing to professionally negotiate for the best reasonable rate.



You should also have strong English communication skills, good judgment, organization and the confidence to manage drivers without needing approval for every routine decision.



Schedule & Support



Our general management and operational support hours are 7:30 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.).



The Fleet Manager will eventually participate in a shared rotating after-hours coverage schedule with management for legitimate time-sensitive driver/load matters. This rotation is designed so management team members also receive protected off-time.



You will not be expected to run the entire back office yourself. Our Agency has operational and administrative support for onboarding, documentation, compliance coordination, revenue tracking, settlements and other back-office functions. Your primary focus is fleet management, freight procurement, negotiation, dispatch and keeping trucks productive.



Compensation



This position will have performance-based compensation tied directly to qualifying freight personally sourced, negotiated, booked and dispatched by the Fleet Manager.



Specific compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates during the interview process.



How to Apply



Please include:



How many years you have dispatched U.S. trucks.

What equipment types you have dispatched.

Which load boards/TMS platforms you have used.

Approximately how many trucks you have managed at one time.

An example of how you negotiate when a broker's first offer is too low.

Your experience planning reloads/backhauls and managing driver HOS.



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily general VA work with little or no hands-on U.S. truck dispatching experience.

title: Video Editor for Food, Travel & Mini-Documentary Content — Ongoing Work
description:
I'm looking for a talented video editor to work with me on food, cocktail, travel and documentary-style content for Instagram, YouTube and Chinese social media.



I'm particularly interested in finding someone for an ongoing working relationship, rather than simply outsourcing a single video.



The first paid project will be Part 2 of a cocktail experiment in which we try to create cocktails using Chinese hotpot ingredients. The finished video will be approximately 2–3 minutes, vertical (9:16).



Reference Video

Please watch the Part 1 reference video before applying:


==



Part 1 establishes the general editing style I'm looking for. I want Part 2 to clearly feel like part of the same series, but I don't want someone to simply copy it.



I'm looking for an editor with strong visual taste and storytelling ability who can understand what I've established and suggest ways to make it better.



This isn't a role where I'm looking simply for someone who knows how to operate editing software. Editorial judgement, storytelling, pacing and taste are important to me.



What I'll Provide



For the first project, I'll provide:

- Organised raw footage

- Voiceover/dialogue

- A reference script/edit structure showing the intended story, voiceover and key moments

- Approved English and Chinese subtitle copy

- The finished Part 1 as the main style reference

- Previous content for additional reference

- Fonts and existing graphics/assets where relevant

- Notes on important moments



The reference script should be treated as a starting point rather than something that has to be followed rigidly.

If you think the story, structure, pacing or presentation could be improved, I actively welcome your suggestions.



What I'm Looking For



I'm particularly interested in editors who are strong at:

- Storytelling and pacing

- Food, travel, documentary or lifestyle content

- Selecting strong B-roll and knowing when to let shots breathe

- Music and sound design

- Clean, considered graphics and typography

- Basic colour grading and audio finishing

- Short-form editing without excessive jump cuts, emojis or generic social-media effects

- Working from an established visual style while bringing your own ideas to it



You can edit in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or another professional NLE. I currently edit my own content in CapCut, so you do not need to use the same software.



Future Work



This first video is intended as a paid test project for a longer-term relationship.



I'm currently producing short documentaries about Chinese food and restaurants in the UK. I've already filmed two in Sheffield; I'll edit the first myself to establish the style, and I'm looking for an editor to take on the second.



I'll also be filming food and culture content in China and elsewhere in Asia.



Longer term, I'd like to find an editor who can take organised raw footage, interviews and a story brief and develop an edit with increasing independence — not someone who needs every cut specified for them.



First Project Deliverables



For the Hotpot Cocktail Part 2 video:



- Approximately 2–3 minute vertical (9:16) edit

- Bilingual English/Chinese subtitles using supplied copy

- Music and sound design

- Graphics consistent with Part 1

- Basic colour and audio finishing

- Two reasonable rounds of revisions

- Final high-quality master

- Clean version without subtitles

- Project/source files and any custom assets created



How to Apply



Please answer all four questions below. Generic applications that don't address these questions will not be considered.



1. Please share ONE video you've edited that you think is most relevant to this project.

Briefly explain why you chose it and what your role was in the edit.



2. Please watch the Part 1 reference video linked above.

What is one element of the editing/style you would keep for Part 2, and one thing you would consider changing or improving?



3. Based on the project description and reference video, approximately how many hours would you expect the first 2–3 minute video to take, including two reasonable rounds of revisions?

Please briefly explain your estimate.



4. I'll provide a reference script/edit structure, but I welcome creative input rather than expecting it to be followed rigidly.

How would you approach suggesting changes if you thought the story, pacing or structure could be improved?

Please also include your hourly rate and your usual availability/turnaround time.



I'm much more interested in seeing one genuinely relevant piece of work and understanding how you think as an editor than receiving a long showreel or list of portfolio links.

title: Acquisitions Specialist – Real Estate Acquisition Deal Making Experience Welcome
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

title: Technical Lead Research & Outreach VA — Gaming / Developer Communities
description:
We are looking for a smart, detail-oriented Research & Outreach VA to help us grow the developer ecosystem around OPEN//77.



OPEN//77 is a multiplayer platform being built for Cyberpunk 2077.



The easiest comparison is FiveM for Cyberpunk: developers and communities will be able to build their own multiplayer servers, custom game modes, roleplay frameworks, Lua resources, and other experiences.



We are preparing our Developer Alpha Preview and our main goal right now is NOT to recruit regular players.



We need to find and recruit:



- FiveM server owners

- FiveM / RedM developers

- Lua developers

- Qbox / QBCore / ESX developers

- Framework developers

- Script/resource creators

- RP server teams

- GitHub contributors

- Garry's Mod developers

- RAGE:MP / alt:V developers

- Cyberpunk modders

- Developers who may want to build resources or servers for OPEN//77

Your main responsibility will be finding highly qualified developers and server creators online and organizing them into a clean lead database.



You will research platforms such as:



- GitHub

- Cfx.re forums

- Cfx Marketplace

- FiveM communities

- Tebex/resource creators

- Server directories

- GmodStore

- RAGE:MP

- YouTube

- X /

- Contributed to Qbox/QBCore/ESX/Ox

Example:

NOT:



"Hi, I found your profile and wanted to introduce our project."



5. Help contact qualified leads using approved outreach messages

WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



We do not want someone who:



- Scrapes thousands of random
s

Quality is much more important than quantity.

You do NOT need to be a developer.



However, you should be comfortable researching technical topics and learning the difference between things like:



- FiveM

- QBCore

- Qbox

- ESX

- Lua

- GitHub repositories

- Server frameworks

- Resources/scripts

- RP servers



Experience with gaming, Discord communities, GitHub, lead generation, SaaS research, developer outreach, or game modding communities is a big plus.



Strong written English is required.

OPEN//77 is building a multiplayer server platform for Cyberpunk 2077.



We already have a working pre-alpha and are preparing a limited Developer Alpha Preview for developers and server owners who want to start building before public release.



Website:





Documentation:





HOW TO APPLY



Please start your application with the words:



NIGHT CITY



Then answer these questions:

2. Are you familiar with GitHub, gaming communities, FiveM, modding, Discord, or developer communities?



3. How would you find developers who have built FiveM resources?



4. What tools do you normally use for research and lead tracking?

Applications without this test will not be considered.

- Comfortable working US hours

title: Executive Assistant & International Business Projects Coordinator
description:
Remote | 90-Day Contract-to-Hire | International Business / Africa / DRC



Compensation: $1,000–$1,300 USD per month, depending on experience

Initial Term: Paid 90-day contract with opportunity for a long-term position



We are seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant & International Business Projects Coordinator to work directly with the founder on international business ventures involving the United States, Africa, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who combines strong executive support skills with business judgment, legal/ document experience, research ability, project management, and intelligent use of ChatGPT and other AI tools.



The successful candidate will support two primary initiatives:

1. International Industrial & Commodity Supply Business

Supporting the development of an international sulfuric acid supply business serving industrial and mining customers in the Democratic Republic of Congo and surrounding African markets.



Responsibilities may include:

Researching qualified international suppliers

Identifying potential buyers and strategic partners

Researching logistics, ports, transportation corridors, and trade considerations

Coordinating communications with suppliers, buyers, attorneys, consultants, and logistics providers

Preparing supplier comparison reports and executive summaries

Tracking negotiations, meetings, documents, and follow-ups

Assisting with preliminary commercial documentation and due diligence



2. DRC Chamber of Commerce Initiative

Supporting the creation and development of a business organization connecting companies, investors, entrepreneurs, institutions, and international partners interested in doing business with the Democratic Republic of Congo.



Responsibilities may include: 

Researching chambers of commerce and international trade organizations

Identifying prospective founding members, sponsors, corporate partners, and institutions

Preparing membership proposals, presentations, correspondence, and research

Coordinating meetings and stakeholder outreach

Maintaining databases of companies and contacts

Assisting with organizational and corporate documentation

Supporting events, partnerships, and membership development 



General Responsibilities



You will also:

Conduct high-quality business and legal research

Prepare concise briefing documents for the founder

Draft professional
s, letters, proposals, presentations, meeting agendas, MOUs, NDAs, and preliminary business documents for review

Maintain project timelines and action items

Follow up consistently with stakeholders

Organize contracts, corporate records, research, and correspondence

Manage projects using ClickUp or similar platforms

Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, analysis, documentation, and project execution

Verify important AI-generated information rather than relying on AI blindly Identify problems, missing information, and recommended next actions



Ideal Background



We are particularly interested in candidates with education or professional experience in one or more of the following:

Business Administration

Law or Paralegal Studies

International Business

International Relations

Corporate Affairs

Economics

Finance

Trade and Logistics

Mining or Commodity Businesses

Government or Institutional Relations



A bachelor's degree is preferred.



Previous experience supporting a CEO, entrepreneur, attorney, consulting firm, international company, chamber of commerce, trade association, government organization, or professional-services firm is highly desirable. 



Required Skills



You should have: 

Excellent written and spoken English

Excellent professional writing skills

Strong research and analytical ability

Strong organizational and follow-up skills

Good understanding of basic business and legal terminology

Ability to work independently

Good professional judgment and discretion

Ability to manage several projects simultaneously

Experience with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar project-management software

Strong experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools professionally



French is a major advantage. 



Knowledge of Africa, international trade, commodities, mining, logistics, corporate affairs, or the Democratic Republic of Congo is also highly valuable. 



The Type of Person We Want



We are not looking for someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every assignment.

For example, you may receive an objective such as: “Identify five credible sulfuric acid suppliers capable of supporting mining operations in Central Africa.”



We expect you to determine how to research the issue, use AI tools intelligently, verify information, organize the findings, identify risks and unanswered questions, and present a concise recommendation. 



We value: Resourcefulness. Judgment. Writing ability. Curiosity. Follow-through. Confidentiality. Speed.



90-Day Contract Period



The successful candidate will initially join under a paid 90-day contract.



During this period, performance will be evaluated based on:

Quality of research

Professional writing

Initiative

Reliability

Organization

Communication

Ability to use AI effectively

Ability to manage follow-ups

Ability to independently move projects forward 



Strong performance may lead to a long-term position with increased responsibility and compensation

. 

Performance or milestone bonuses may also be available for exceptional contribution to major business milestones. 



How to Apply

Please submit:

Your résumé or CV

Your current country and time zone

Your expected monthly compensation

A short description of your business, legal, international, or executive-support experience

A short description of how you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work



Please also answer the following question:

You have been asked to identify and evaluate international sulfuric acid suppliers capable of serving mining companies in the Democratic Republic of Congo. What are the first five steps you would take? 



﻿Please keep your answer concise and practical. Generic AI-generated applications without evidence of independent thinking may not be considered.

title: Meta Ads Specialist + Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
description:
About EE Media Productions



We are a Canadian video production and social media agency based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. We produce content and run social media for clients in real estate, health and wellness, hospitality, and professional services. You will be working directly with the owner on real client accounts, not on practice work.



About the Role



This role is two things at once, and you need to be strong at both.



1. Meta Ads. You will set up, run, and optimize
 and Instagram ad campaigns for our clients and for EE Media.

2. Social Media Management. You will plan, create, schedule, and publish content, and manage the community around it.



If you can do social media but have never built a real campaign in Ads Manager, this is not the role. If you can run ads but cannot produce good-looking content, it is also not the role. We need both.



This is not a beginner position. We need someone who can work independently, think on their feet, solve problems on their own, and consistently deliver polished work with minimal supervision. If you require constant instructions, frequent follow-ups, or step-by-step guidance for every task, this role will not be a good fit.



Meta Ads Requirements (the part we screen hardest on)



You must be able to do all of the following without hand-holding:



* Build a campaign from scratch in Ads Manager. Boosting posts from the Page is not the same thing and does not count

* Choose the right objective, conversion location, and performance goal for a given business outcome

* Set up and troubleshoot the pixel, standard events, and custom conversions

* Know what Special Ad Categories are and when they apply. Several of our clients are in real estate, so Housing comes up often

* Build and manage audiences, budgets, and schedules

* Read the results and know what to change, what to leave alone, and when it is too early to judge

* Write ad copy that stays inside Meta's advertising policies



Social Media Management Responsibilities



* Develop and implement social media strategies and monthly content calendars

* Create, schedule, and publish posts across agreed platforms

* Manage scheduling and publishing through SocialBee

* Create graphics and simple video edits for social content

* Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and mentions, and engage the online community

* Track and analyze performance metrics and provide regular reports

* Stay updated on social media trends and apply strategies to grow reach and engagement

* Organize project files and maintain efficient workflows

* Meet deadlines consistently and communicate proactively



Must-Have Skills



* Fluent in English, both written and spoken

* Proven Meta Ads experience, as described above

* Very familiar with Meta Business Suite and Business Manager

* Familiar with SocialBee

* Good graphic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar)

* Knows some video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

* Strong understanding of social media content and current trends



Working Hours



* 10 to 20 hours per week, flexible within Philippine business hours

* You must be reachable on WhatsApp within 15 to 30 minutes during your working hours

* One short written update at the end of each of your working days, so it is waiting for us when Winnipeg wakes up

* Occasional calls will be scheduled with advance notice to find a time that works for both sides



Personality Traits We Value



* Resourceful and proactive

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Detail-oriented

* Fast learner

* Reliable and accountable

* Able to work with little to no supervision

* Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions



Bonus Points



* Newsletter and
 marketing experience (Mailchimp)

* Copywriting or caption-writing experience

* WordPress and basic SEO

* Experience with real estate or premium brand content

* Experience reporting on paid ad results and analytics







Rate



CAD $8 per hour



Hiring Process



1. We review applications that followed the instructions below

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a short PAID test task, about one hour, paid at the hourly rate

3. A short call

4. Start



Application Instructions



To apply, please do all of the following:



* Start your message with the phrase "EE Creative" so we know you read this post to the end

* Include a link to your portfolio (graphic design and social media samples, plus any Meta Ads results or case studies you can share)

* Describe one Meta Ads campaign you managed in two or three sentences. Tell us the objective you chose, the conversion location, what the cost per result was, and what you changed to improve it

* Record a short 30 to 45 second video introducing yourself and send it to our WhatsApp: [YOUR NUMBER HERE]



APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS ABOVE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED

title: Experienced Credit Repair Specialist – FCRA/CFPB
description:
## Experienced Credit Repair Specialist Needed



We are looking for an experienced **Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Dispute Specialist** who understands U.S. consumer credit laws and can independently review credit reports, identify inaccurate or questionable negative items, prepare customized disputes, and properly document all activity inside **Credit Repair Cloud**.



### REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE



You must be familiar with:



* FCRA — Fair Credit Reporting Act

* FACTA — Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act

* FDCPA — Fair Debt Collection Practices Act

* CFPB complaint procedures

* FTC Identity Theft procedures

* HIPAA as it relates to applicable medical debt/privacy situations

* Credit bureau dispute procedures

* Creditor and collection agency disputes

* Identity theft blocking procedures

* Consumer reporting agency freezes



### CREDIT REPAIR CLOUD EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



You must have experience using **Credit Repair Cloud** as a credit repair CRM.



You should know how to:



* Add and manage clients

* Import/analyze credit reports

* Track negative tradelines

* Track dispute rounds

* Update client progress

* Update CRM at the 15-day, 30-day, and 45-day stages

* Track dispute letters that have been sent

* Record bureau responses

* Track deletions and account updates

* Record creditor and collection agency responses

* Create and manage follow-up actions

* Keep detailed client notes

* Maintain organized client files and documentation

* Track the complete dispute history for each client



### CREDIT REPORT EXPERIENCE



You must know how to analyze credit reports from platforms such as:



* Experian

* Equifax

* TransUnion

* MyFICO

* SmartCredit

* IdentityIQ

* PrivacyGuard

* Credit Karma

* Identity Guard

* Other credit monitoring platforms



You should be able to identify and analyze:



* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Late payments

* Repossessions

* Closed derogatory accounts

* Inaccurate balances

* Duplicate accounts

* Incorrect account statuses

* Incorrect dates

* Payment history inconsistencies

* Accounts reporting differently between bureaus

* Unauthorized hard inquiries

* Potential identity theft accounts

* Other inaccurate or unverifiable information



### RESPONSIBILITIES



The selected specialist will be responsible for:



* Reviewing all three credit bureaus

* Identifying negative tradelines

* Identifying inconsistencies between Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Developing an appropriate dispute strategy for each client

* Creating customized dispute letters for Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Creating customized letters for original creditors

* Creating customized letters for collection agencies and debt buyers

* Preparing follow-up disputes when necessary

* Updating **Credit Repair Cloud** throughout the dispute process

* Updating client files approximately every 15, 30, and 45 days

* Keeping detailed records of disputes, responses, deletions, updates, and next actions

* Reviewing bureau investigation results

* Reviewing creditor and collector responses

* Escalating legitimate unresolved reporting issues when appropriate



### FREEZE EXPERIENCE



You should know how to properly submit and manage security freezes or freeze requests with:



* Equifax

* Experian

* TransUnion

* LexisNexis

* Innovis

* ARS

* CoreLogic

* SageStream



You should understand when a freeze is appropriate and when it is not.



### CFPB / FTC EXPERIENCE



You must understand how to:



* Prepare and submit legitimate CFPB complaints

* Include supporting documentation

* Create a clear timeline of the dispute

* Determine when CFPB escalation is appropriate

* Properly use FTC IdentityTheft.gov procedures for legitimate identity theft cases

* Prepare supporting documentation for legitimate identity theft disputes



**We will not use false identity theft claims or fraudulent dispute tactics.**



### IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply sends the same generic dispute template to every client.



We want someone who understands the complete process:



**Analyze → Identify inaccuracies/inconsistencies → Determine the correct dispute strategy → Create customized disputes → Track everything in Credit Repair Cloud → Review responses → Follow up → Escalate when justified**



Attention to detail and organization are extremely important.



### TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years have you worked in credit repair?

2. Approximately how many client credit files have you handled?

3. How many years of experience do you have using **Credit Repair Cloud**?

4. What tasks have you personally performed inside Credit Repair Cloud?

5. Which credit monitoring platforms are you experienced with?

6. Explain the difference between an FCRA dispute and an FDCPA dispute.

7. When would you dispute directly with a creditor or furnisher instead of only disputing with the credit bureaus?

8. What would you look for when the same account is reporting differently between Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion?

9. Have you prepared CFPB complaints before? Explain your experience.

10. Have you handled legitimate identity theft disputes involving FTC Identity Theft Reports?

11. Are you experienced with LexisNexis, Innovis, CoreLogic, SageStream, and ARS freezes?

12. What is your process after receiving a bureau investigation result?

13. What information do you normally track inside Credit Repair Cloud during a 30–45 day dispute cycle?

14. How do you determine whether to send another dispute, dispute with the furnisher, or escalate the issue?



Please start your onlinejobs.ph proposal with the words:



**“CREDIT REPAIR CLOUD”**



If you do not include those words, your application may not be reviewed.

title: Virtual Bookkeeping Lead
description:
# Experienced U.S. Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Online Specialist



**Remote | Full-Time or Long-Term Role**

**Compensation: Up to $1,200 USD/month**



Phænix Advisory Services is a boutique CPA and advisory firm based on the U.S. West Coast. We work with small businesses, business owners, and real estate investors.



We are looking for an experienced **U.S. Bookkeeper / Accounting Assistant** to join our team.



This is **not a general virtual assistant position**. We are looking for someone with strong hands-on bookkeeping experience, especially with **QuickBooks Online and U.S.-based clients**.



## What You’ll Do



You will help manage the bookkeeping for a portfolio of small-business clients.



Responsibilities include:



- Monthly bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

- Bank and credit card reconciliations

- Transaction categorization and review

- Balance sheet account review

- Accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Payroll reconciliation

- Basic journal entries

- Loan and fixed asset tracking

- 1099 vendor tracking and support

- Month-end close procedures

- Cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping

- Preparing Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

- Identifying accounting errors or unusual transactions

- Requesting missing information from clients

- Maintaining organized workpapers and documentation

- Communicating with our internal accounting team



Our clients may include small businesses, LLCs, S corporations, real estate investors, and rental-property owners.



## Required Experience



You should have:



- **3+ years of professional U.S. bookkeeping experience**

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Experience managing multiple small-business clients

- Strong bank and credit card reconciliation skills

- Understanding of U.S. bookkeeping and accounting principles

- Experience reviewing Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to identify problems instead of simply processing transactions

- Strong written English communication

- Reliable internet and remote-work setup

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Availability for some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



## Preferred Experience



Bonus points if you have:



- 5+ years of bookkeeping experience

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

- Experience working for a U.S. CPA or bookkeeping firm

- Experience with LLCs and S corporations

- Real estate or rental-property bookkeeping experience

- Cleanup/catch-up bookkeeping experience

- Month-end closing experience

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and 1099 reporting



## Who We’re Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to enter transactions.



We want someone who can look at a set of books and recognize when something **doesn’t make sense**.



You should be:



- Diligent

- Dependable

- Detail-oriented

- Organized

- Hard-working

- Comfortable asking questions

- Able to follow procedures

- Able to work independently

- Accountable for deadlines and quality



Accuracy and quality are extremely important to us.



## Schedule



This is a fully remote position.



Because our firm is based on the U.S. West Coast, you must be able to maintain some reasonable working-hour overlap with **Pacific Time**.



Exact hours can be discussed.



## Compensation



**Up to $1,200 USD per month**, depending on experience, skill level, availability, and responsibilities.



There is potential for increased responsibility and growth for someone who proves they can independently manage high-quality client bookkeeping.



## How to Apply



Please answer **all of the questions below** in your application:

title: Acquisitions Specialist — Outreach, Negotiation & Deal Closing
description:
IF YOU'VE DONE REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS, WHOLESALING, OR DEAL-CLOSING — READ THIS

This is the same work you already do, just a different asset. If you've sourced off-market properties, cold-called owners who weren't listed, negotiated a price, and closed the transfer — you have exactly the skill set we need. Swap "distressed property" for "online community" and the job is identical: find the owner, figure out what it's worth, reach out, and close.



WHO WE ARE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities. We're hiring a sharp closer to acquire them for us. The assets are Reddit communities — but we'll teach you the platform mechanics. What we can't teach is deal instinct and judgment, and that's what we're actually hiring for.



THE JOB, DAY TO DAY

• Start from a list of candidate communities our software pulls for you, and d
 which are worth going after

• Size up each one's real worth — the right niche, genuine demand, real commercial upside — not just the headline numbers

• Track down the owner and reach them across the right channels (often their public social profiles) to open a conversation

• Negotiate and close the deal — either moderation rights or a full ownership transfer

• Coordinate the handoff once terms are agreed

• Keep a tidy pipeline of targets, conversations, deals, and spend



WHAT MATTERS MOST (in this order)

1. Judgment — anyone can read a traffic stat. The rare skill is knowing whether a community is actually worth paying for, and how much, without us in the room for every call.

2. Closing — cold-reaching a stranger, warming them up, negotiating, and getting the deal done. This is the bulk of the work.



Reddit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — the platform side is quick to pick up. If you're a strong closer who's never touched Reddit, still apply.



WHO YOU LIKELY ARE

• A real estate acquisitions / disposition VA, wholesaler, cold caller, domain or website flipper, or anyone who sources and closes deals for a living

• You can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable reaching out to strangers and closing them

• You run your own pipeline with little oversight

• Clear written English

• Nice-to-have: Reddit, affiliate, or SEO background



COMPENSATION

Competitive base + a bonus on every deal you close. Strong closers earn well here.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Walk me through one deal you sourced and closed yourself — a property, domain, website, whatever. How'd you find it, how'd you d
 what it was worth, and how'd you close it?

2. When you size up an online asset, what actually tells you it's worth paying for versus something that just looks big? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't trying to sell. How do you reach them and open the negotiation?

4. Your desired rate or salary.

title: AI Video Ad Creator / AI Video Editor
description:
We are building a creative agency specializing in high-quality AI-generated video advertisements for businesses.



We are looking for a talented AI Video Ad Creator who can transform simple product photos, videos, and client assets into realistic, professional, attention-grabbing advertisements using AI.



This is NOT a traditional video editing position.



We need someone who knows how to generate scenes with AI, not just edit existing footage.



What You Will Create



You will create short-form video advertisements (typically 15–30 seconds) for different types of businesses and products.



Your work may include:



* AI-generated product advertisements

* Realistic AI actors/models using products

* AI UGC-style ads

* Cinematic product videos

* Product demonstrations

* Social media ads for Meta, Instagram and TikTok

* Multiple hooks and creative variations

* Voiceovers, captions, music and sound design



You will often receive only product photos/videos + a creative brief/reference, and your job will be to transform those assets into a complete professional advertisement.



AI Tools



Experience with tools such as:



* Veo / Google Flow

* Kling AI

* Higgsfield

* Runway

* Nano Banana

* Midjourney / Flux

* ElevenLabs

* CapCut / Premiere Pro

* Other AI image/video generation tools



You DO NOT need to know every tool.



We care much more about the quality of your final work than which tools you use.



What We’re Looking For



1. Excellent AI Generation Quality



Your content should look realistic and professional — not obviously AI-generated or low quality.



2. Advertising Creativity



You understand:



* Strong hooks

* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Product benefits

* Attention retention

* Calls to action

* Direct-response advertising



We don’t just want beautiful videos.



We want advertisements that can sell.



3. Speed & Consistency



You should be able to consistently produce high-quality content and handle multiple projects.



4. Willingness to Learn



AI tools evolve extremely quickly. We want someone who enjoys testing new tools, techniques and workflows.



Compensation



Starting salary: $650/month — Full-Time



This is intended to be a long-term position.



There will be opportunities for salary increases and bonuses based on:



* Quality

* Reliability

* Production capacity

* Performance

* Growth of the company



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



AI CREATIVE



Applications that don’t start with these words may not be reviewed.



Then answer these questions:



1. Portfolio:

Send us a link to your portfolio.



2. Your BEST work:

Send links to your 3 best AI-generated advertisements/videos.



Please don’t send 20+ videos. We want to see your strongest work.



3. AI Tools:

Which AI tools do you currently use?



4. AI involvement:

For each of your 3 examples, briefly explain what was generated with AI and what you personally created.



5. Production Speed:

Approximately how long would it take you to create one high-quality 15–30 second AI advertisement from product photos?



6. Experience:

Tell us briefly about your experience creating advertisements or commercial content.



7. Availability:

Are you currently available for a full-time position?



Selection Process



We will review applications primarily based on portfolio quality.



The best candidates will be shortlisted and invited to complete a paid creative test.



All shortlisted candidates will receive the same product assets and brief so we can evaluate creativity, AI generation quality, advertising skills and execution.



We are looking for someone who can grow with us long-term.



If you are passionate about AI video creation and believe you can turn ordinary product assets into exceptional advertisements, we’d love to see your work.
